# Evidence Bundle v1 fixture

Generated by `python scripts/gen_evidence_fixture.py` (not by pytest).

```bash
airlock verify-bundle tests/fixtures/evidence_bundle/sample-evidence-bundle.zip \
  --pubkey tests/fixtures/evidence_bundle/auditor-trusted.pem
```

Exit 0 = authentic + recount VERIFIED (replay_compromised — not live-model).
Exit 1 = authentic + recount FAILED. Exit 2 = authentic incomplete/inconclusive.
Exit 19 = unexpected/internal (fail-closed). The PEM is the out-of-band trust anchor for this fixture; bundled signing.pub is convenience only.
